evidence.title: Trump aide's daughter pictured with pro-Russia politician

occurrences.checkable_against: RIS shooting range location records and Bosnian media reports
occurrences.quote_span: The RIS shooting range is located in northern Republika Srpska and is frequented by Budimir, the interior minister, according to Bosnian media reports.
occurrences.speaker: Bosnian media reports
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Continental Strategy website
occurrences.quote_span: Katie Wiles is a partner at Continental Strategy, a large political lobbying firm based in Washington, D.C., according to its website.
occurrences.speaker: Continental Strategy
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: FARA disclosures and U.S. government contact records
occurrences.quote_span: "Garcia is the sole person who has interacted with the United States government regarding Srpska, and his contacts have all been meticulously tracked to be reported in accordance with FARA requirements," the spokesperson said.
occurrences.speaker: Continental Strategy spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Evi Kokalari's X post

occurrences.speaker: Evi Kokalari
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: satellite imagery and prior shooting-range social-media posts
occurrences.quote_span: CBS News confirmed the veracity of the images through satellite imagery and previous social media posts from the shooting range where the image was captured.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Katie Wiles' personal Instagram account and the screenshot
occurrences.quote_span: The image appears to be a screenshot of a story from Wiles' personal Instagram account, with a caption "mostly work + some serious fun!"
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Dayton Accords records and Dodik's public conduct
occurrences.quote_span: Serbian secessionist leader Dodik, who until recently served as the president of Republika Srpska, has long been accused of undermining the U.S.-brokered Dayton Accords, which ended the bloody sectarian violence between Bosnia, Croatia and Serbia in the 1990s.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Continental Strategy website and corporate records
occurrences.quote_span: Garcia is also a partner at Continental Strategy.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: the image and CBS News verification records
occurrences.quote_span: An image circulated on social media and verified by CBS News shows Katie Wiles, the daughter of White House chief of staff Susie Wiles, recently traveled to Republika Srpska, the Bosnian-controlled territory led by pro-Russian Serb strongman Milorad Dodik.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Katie Wiles communications records and U.S. government contact logs
occurrences.quote_span: Wiles has not spoken with any United States Government official regarding Srpska."
occurrences.speaker: Continental Strategy spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: CBS News verification records, satellite imagery and source social-media posts
occurrences.quote_span: CBS News Confirmed has verified the image is of Wiles and that it was taken in Republika Srpska.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: FARA filings and Republika Srpska government records
occurrences.quote_span: Under the control of Dodik's party, Republika Srpska has forged close ties with President Vladimir Putin's government in Russia, while also spending heavily on U.S.-based lobbying firms to court associates of Mr. Trump, according to FARA filings reviewed by CBS News.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Continental Strategy statement to CBS News
occurrences.quote_span: A spokesperson for the firm acknowledged to CBS News Thursday that Wiles had taken the trip in mid-August but on business for another client of Continental Strategy.
occurrences.speaker: Continental Strategy spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Continental Strategy client and work records
occurrences.quote_span: Wiles provides strategic communications support to this US company and has done so for over two years.
occurrences.speaker: Continental Strategy spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: the circulated image and Republika Srpska administrative records
occurrences.quote_span: The image, shared online by conservative Albanian American activist Evi Kokalari, shows Wiles holding a rifle and standing next to a man CBS News has identified as Željko Budimir, the interior minister of the semi-autonomous Republika Srpska administration.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Department of Justice FARA filing for Alejandro Garcia
occurrences.quote_span: Another FARA filing from the same firm this year lists the signature of Alejandro Garcia, a former deputy political director for Mr. Trump's presidential campaign, as a consultant for Republika Srpska.
occurrences.speaker: CBS News
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: Continental Strategy statement to CBS News
occurrences.quote_span: "Katie Wiles visited the country in mid-August for two days with a U.S.-based company who was invited to do a feasibility study in the region," the spokesperson said.
occurrences.speaker: Continental Strategy spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles

occurrences.checkable_against: White House communications and Susie Wiles' statements
occurrences.quote_span: "Susie does not discuss work matters with her daughters," a White House official told CBS News Thursday.
occurrences.speaker: White House official
occurrences.subject: Katie Wiles
